title: Episode About the Creation the Khalsa Panth

blocks.text: Guru Gobind Singh prepares the amrit while uttering the divine Names, reciting martial bani, and binding the new ceremony to both remembrance of Akal Purakh and the line of the ten Gurus. (7–10)
The initiation is then given to the first five, the Panj Pyare, through one bowl and one discipline, making the new order an embodied brotherhood rather than a symbolic gesture. (11–12)
The page presents the amrit ceremony as both liturgical and martial: prayer, steel, shared draught, and collective rebirth are fused into a single founding act. (overall)
